story: Kofi and Hana talk about their different jobs. Kofi works in a big office for a large company, while Hana works on a farm. They discuss their busy work lives.
title: Different Jobs
setting: A small cafe with a table and chairs.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: A young man with short black hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: A young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater.

sentences.en: Kofi works in a large office.
sentences.zh: Kofi 在一间大办公室里工作。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young man with short black hair and a blue shirt, sits at a desk in a large office.

sentences.en: His new job is not boring.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi looks happy and busy at his desk in the office.

sentences.en: He works for a big company.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi stands in front of a large building with a company logo.

sentences.en: He has a meeting with his team.
sentences.zh: 他要和他的团队开个会。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi sits at a large table with three other workers for a meeting.

sentences.en: Hana is a hard worker on a farm.
sentences.zh: Hana 是一个勤劳的农场工人。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young woman with long brown hair and a green sweater, stands on a green farm.

sentences.en: She is a farmer and loves her business.
sentences.zh: 她是一名农民，很热爱她的生意。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana holds a basket of vegetables on the farm.

sentences.en: A waiter and a waitress work here.
sentences.zh: 一名男服务员和一名女服务员在这里工作。
sentences.scene_prompt: A male waiter and a female waitress carry plates in a pretty cafe.

sentences.en: The cafe is on the left side.
sentences.scene_prompt: A pretty cafe is located on the left side of a street.
